item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Sleep. Your calendar already has a wind-down built in: relaxation in the evening, then a set bedtime at 22:15. That structure is your advantage, so protect it. Late calls and note-taking can stretch past the plan, so keep them short. Dim the lights, put screens away, and let your body get the signal that the day is done. Tonight, start your relaxation at 20:30 and don't skip it.
